title: BugGenome
description: Flat gene vector. Every gene is a scalar. Integer genes are marked. Order of keys is the canonical vector order used for crossover.

leg_length.description: Normalized femur+tibia length relative to body length.

leg_spread.description: How far legs splay from the body axis. Affects stability.

body_mass.description: Density multiplier, independent of volume. Replaces carapace_thickness for shell/defense too; blended a minority share with the derived body-size coefficient.

wing_area.description: Overall wing SIZE — scales length and width together. 0 = flightless.

wing_length.description: Blade length along its own axis. Feeds the shape coefficient.

wing_width.description: Blade half-width as a fraction of length. Feeds the shape coefficient.

wing_roundness.description: Blunt vs. tapered tip. Outline only; feeds the shape coefficient.

wing_angle.description: Sweep off the body axis. The mapping is 35deg at 0 to 165deg at 1, but the reachable window is 0.7-1.0 (126deg-165deg); 0.85 = 145.5deg at rest. Flight subtracts 0.3 in the renderer.

wing_tip_hue.description: Tip wash: 0 = white, 1-10 = a reference-palette swatch.

mandible_serration.description: Bite multiplier. The renderer buckets it to 0/1/2 teeth on the blade mandibles.

horn_serration.description: Discrete horn detail: 0 smooth, 1 one notch per side, 2 two. Ignored by the crown horn.

metabolism.description: Energy burn rate. High = fast recovery, fast starvation.

aggression.description: Behavioural gene — biases the AI state machine, not a combat stat.

mandible_type.description: wide_thin / narrow_thick / chelicerae. The chelicerae fang is a serration level, not a kind.

pattern_horn.description: Horn surface treatment: min(3, floor(v x 4)) -> flat / gradient / dots / oval.

pattern_mandible.description: Mandible surface treatment, same four buckets and independent of the horn's.

pattern_scale.description: Shared: dot size and count for the dots treatment.

pattern_contrast.description: Shared: how loud whichever treatment each component picked reads.

light_hue.description: Body-segment lighting colour: an index into the fixed reference palette. 7 = cream.
